BrochureContent.Content:
BARRY AUCTIONEERS & VALUERS are delighted to bring to the market this splendid three bedroom end of terrace family home located in one of Cork’s most established and sought-after residential areas. The house is on a corner site with off street parking for two cars to the front and a private rear garden with side access.

Situated in a mature setting this property is within walking distance of The Wilton Shopping Centre and Cork University Hospital and is close to a host of local services and amenities, including shops, schools, sports facilities and cafes.  
 
Viewing is highly recommended.
